raw:
{
  "feasibility": {
    "verdict": "Feasible as a controlled soil-texture sensitivity experiment; direct validation is limited.",
    "answerable": [
      "Relative sensitivity of simulated sub-surface drainage (QDRAI) to soil texture across representative agricultural columns",
      "How texture modulates water-table depth, soil moisture partitioning, and drainage vs surface runoff",
      "Ranking of texture endmembers by long-term mean and seasonal drainage flux"
    ],
    "not_answerable": [
      "Absolute validation of tile-drain flow (no tile-drain observations available)",
      "Explicit engineered tile-drainage dynamics (standard ELM has no tile-drain module without added capability)",
      "Spatially continuous basin-wide drainage maps (single-column archetype, not distributed)"
    ]
  },
  "n_columns": 6,
  "n_justification": "Six columns span the dominant soil-texture endmembers of the Upper Iowa agricultural landscape (sand through clay) while holding climate forcing, vegetation, and topography controls constant, isolating texture as the sole varied driver for a clean sensitivity analysis.",
  "columns": [
    {"id": "UI_sand",      "lat": 43.45, "lon": -92.10, "soil_texture": "sand"},
    {"id": "UI_sandyloam", "lat": 43.40, "lon": -92.30, "soil_texture": "sandy loam"},
    {"id": "UI_loam",      "lat": 43.38, "lon": -91.90, "soil_texture": "loam"},
    {"id": "UI_siltloam",  "lat": 43.35, "lon": -91.70, "soil_texture": "silt loam"},
    {"id": "UI_siltyclayloam", "lat": 43.30, "lon": -91.50, "soil_texture": "silty clay loam"},
    {"id": "UI_clay",      "lat": 43.28, "lon": -91.35, "soil_texture": "clay"}
  ],
  "elm_config": {
    "DATM_CLMNCEP_YR_START": "1980",
    "DATM_CLMNCEP_YR_END": "2018",
    "STOP_N": "39",
    "RUN_STARTDATE": "1980-01-01",
    "hist_variables": [
      "QDRAI",
      "QDRAI_PERCH",
      "QOVER",
      "QRUNOFF",
      "QINFL",
      "ZWT",
      "ZWT_PERCH",
      "H2OSOI",
      "SOILLIQ",
      "SOILICE",
      "RAIN",
      "SNOW",
      "QFLX_EVAP_TOT",
      "TSOI",
      "WA"
    ]
  },
  "requires_capabilities": [
    "Single-column (PTS_MODE) ELM configuration",
    "User-specified soil texture (sand/clay percentage) per column via surface dataset override",
    "GSWP3 or CRUNCEP atmospheric forcing 1980-2018",
    "Accelerated-decomposition + regular spinup prior to transient run",
    "PFLOTRAN coupling optional for detailed variably-saturated subsurface drainage physics"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Agricultural land cover (managed C3/C4 crop or rainfed generic crop PFT) applied uniformly so texture is the isolated variable",
    "Flat topographic slope and identical fmax/aquifer parameters across columns to remove topographic confounding",
    "First years of the run treated as spin-up/discard; analysis focuses on 1990-2018 climatology",
    "Sub-surface drainage represented by ELM baseflow/QDRAI term as a proxy for tile-drain flux since no tile-drain module or observations exist",
    "Soil texture held vertically uniform per column unless a layered profile is later specified"
  ]
}
